capabilities: add "> " markers to each line of selected text
operate on the cursor's line when nothing is selected
trigger integrate and un-integrate via hotkeys, command palette, or mobile toolbar
extras: Mobile toolbar icons are unconfigured and show as question marks; the author lists fixing them as a to-do item. README includes installation and setup steps for desktop and mobile.
intentEvidence: easier integration of long blocks of text into callouts
problem: Manually adding a '>' prefix to each line when moving a long block of text into a callout is tedious, and Obsidian has no built-in command for it.
summary: Command-based tool that adds or removes '> ' blockquote markers on every line of a text selection so it fits inside a callout.
